Name: Leo's Treehouse Renovation
Author: BeazNees
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Redesigned the small treehouse Leo gets when he moves to mainland after his 6 hearts event.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Brings a bit of style and toys to Leo's treehouse. I always thought it looked so boring,  so I decided to spice is up![/size][/color]

[center][size=5][b]Main Features[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Full Leo Treehouse map replacement[/size][/color]

[center][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/color]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40083]Have More Kids and Adopt Leo[/url][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][i]NOT[/i] compatible with any and all mods that edits the LeoTreeHouse map.[/size][/color]

[center][size=5][b]Shout Outs[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Thanks for the people in stardew modding servers for their help with code as well as graphics.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Big thanks to Iro for his wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40281]Tilesheetinator[/url] [/size][/color][size=3]that makes map edits as easy as clicking a menu option![/size]
